purpose: Numerical regression of existing annotations; not a semantic rescoring benchmark

privacy.senders: Stable anonymous labels; mapping not published
privacy.messages: Every text/media/system body replaced with a fixed placeholder
privacy.tags: Replaced with record kind; original tags not published
privacy.dimensions: Mapped from a fixed group collaboration category allowlist
privacy.retained: Original timestamps, order and two numerical deltas; expected index/OHLC only
privacy.omitted: Names, user IDs, contact details, attachments, URLs, local paths and source identifiers
privacy.limitations: Timestamps and numerical trajectories remain observable. Placeholder lengths change interaction-volume values; this fixture does not reproduce original volume or event tags.
